explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of love and calls His children to righteousness.
The attribute of God's nature that drives Him to give His only Son for humanity's salvation.
The concept of believers who have received new life through Jesus Christ and are adopted into God's family.
The sinful existence outside of God, characterized by darkness and hostility toward the divine.
To break with God's will or to live according to the flesh instead of following the Spirit.
The qualities of those who live in accordance with God's laws, setting them apart from the power of sin.
The state of living honestly and in harmony with God's word, the opposite of falsehood.
The holy power that testifies that a person is born again and has a relationship with God.
